verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports running agents across many backends (local, Docker, VMs, cloud) and building automations triggered by schedules or webhooks (Slack, GitHub, Linear), plus API access for scripting — all of which enable running multiple tasks in parallel across infrastructure. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dashboard or orchestration layer for managing many concurrent agent runs, concurrency limits, or throughput metrics for an engineering lead. Missing for 10: explicit multi-task concurrency/orchestration UI, stated concurrency limits or scaling guarantees, and independent evidence of teams running many parallel agents successfully.
